ios.desc:
$247. Seven people. Three shared appetizers. One person had water.

The receipt already knows who ordered what. Now your phone does too.

splitty reads any receipt in seconds—every item, every modifier, every tax line. Tap to assign who got what. Send Venmo requests before the waiter comes back. 30 seconds. Done.

HOW IT WORKS

Snap a photo of the receipt. splitty reads every line item automatically—dishes, drinks, modifiers ("add bacon +$2"), tax, and tip. No typing.

Items start split equally. Tap to tweak who got what. Shared the truffle fries? Mark it split between the people who actually ate them. Tax and tip distribute proportionally—the salad person pays salad-level tax, not ribeye-level.

When you're done, send payment requests directly. Venmo, Cash App, PayPal, Monzo, Revolut—one tap each. Pre-filled amounts. Pre-filled notes. No "I'll get you next time."

WHAT SPLITTY DOES

Reads receipts with 99%+ accuracy. Splits items fairly (not just equally). Sends payment requests in one tap. Works with 10+ payment methods. No account required.

WHAT SPLITTY DOESN'T DO

Track ongoing expenses (use Splitwise for roommates). Manage multi-day trips (use Splid for vacations). Convert currencies.

Different tools for different problems. splitty does one thing: split tonight's dinner, right now, as fast as possible.

THE DETAILS

4.7 stars on the App Store. 3 free splits, then $9.99/year or $24.99 lifetime. Your friends don't need the app—they just get a Venmo request. No ads. No daily limits. No data sold.

Everyone pays what they ordered. Nobody has to bring it up.

quotes.text:
splitty's the easiest way to split receipts with friends. and today, i'd love to share the fastest, most accurate, and most powerful version yet with all of you at HN.

splitting the bill at a restaurant is inefficient and unfair. it’s also annoying for your waiter. with splitty, take a photo of your receipt, select the food everyone ate, and it’ll charge your friends the exact amount they owe (incl. tax + tip) on Venmo. it also works with receipts in your camera roll (& soon, electronic receipts) and keeps a history of receipts you’ve split.

in the last 2 weeks since launch, 200+ people have used splitty to split bills among friends. and their feedback has been incredible:

check splitty out on the App Store. i'd love your feedback.
